name: SPAR-Bench-RGBD
description:
🎯 SPAR-Bench-RGBD
	


A depth-enhanced version of SPAR-Bench for evaluating 3D-aware spatial reasoning in vision-language models.

SPAR-Bench-RGBD extends the full SPAR-Bench with additional depths, camera intrinsics, and pose information, enabling evaluation of models with geometric or 3D-awareness capabilities.The benchmark contains 7,207 manually verified QA pairs across 20 spatial tasks and supports single-view and multi-view inputs.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jasonzhango/SPAR-Bench-RGBD.
reputation: An emerging, manually verified benchmark for 3D-aware spatial reasoning in vision-language models with growing interest among VLM researchers.
